I'll solve this step-by-step using Python to calculate the binomial coefficient and sum its digits.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-RSI/ebd00391-ba98-5b98-9125-83abd1dce979/scratchpad && python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate C(53, 13) - the binomial coefficient "53 choose 13"
c_53_13 = math.comb(53, 13)
print(f"C(53, 13) = {c_53_13}")

# Convert to string to extract individual digits
digits_str = str(c_53_13)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits_str)}")
print(f"Digits: {digits_str}")

# Sum all the decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in digits_str)
print(f"\nSum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")

# Verify by showing the calculation
print(f"\nVerification:")
individual_digits = [int(d) for d in digits_str]
print(f"Individual digits: {individual_digits}")
print(f"Sum: {' + '.join(str(d) for d in individual_digits)} = {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
